remarks: Grand Finale “110”: A Masterpiece of Refined Living    Reimagined from top to bottom with more than $400,000 in designer craftsmanship, this rare Casa Palma residence presents 2,231 square feet of light-filled, single-level elegance, among the largest and most coveted floorplans in Laguna Woods Village. Set on a serene, single-loaded street, the home is approached through a private gated courtyard and an expanded entry with grand double doors, opening to a formal foyer that sets an unmistakable sense of arrival.
